copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 它会从 channels 分支复制 Teams 适配器到 src/channels/ 并注册、装好固定版本的 @chat-adapter/teams，再构建跑注册测试；随后引导登录 Microsoft 365、创建安装机器人、写凭据进 .env。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Microsoft Teams 频道时触发：先执行 Apply 里的复制、注册、安装、构建测试步骤，再进入凭据配置流程。

say.text: 帮我把 Microsoft Teams 频道接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并跑注册测试

say.text: 接着配置 Teams 机器人凭据，机器人叫 NanoClaw
say.note: 会引导登录 Microsoft 365 并创建机器人

say.text: 我的隧道地址变了，用 teams app update 更新
say.note: 改端点而不是重新创建应用

howto.what_en: It copies the Teams adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/teams, and runs the registration test. Then it guides Microsoft 365 sign-in, bot creation, and writing credentials to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add Microsoft Teams channel integration to NanoClaw: it runs the Apply steps (copy, register, install, build and test) and then the credential setup flow.

say_en.text: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and runs the registration test

say_en.text: Now set up the Teams bot credentials, name it NanoClaw
say_en.note: Guides Microsoft 365 sign-in and bot creation

say_en.text: My tunnel URL changed, update the Teams app
say_en.note: Runs teams app update instead of re-creating
